prompt.text:
Implement `moveViewport(currentIndex, command, itemCount)`. `itemCount` must be a positive safe integer, and `currentIndex` must be an integer from zero through `itemCount - 1`; otherwise throw `RangeError`. `command` must be `'forward'`, `'backward'`, or an object with exactly meaningful fields `{ type: 'jump', index }`, where `index` is a valid integer in the same range. Unsupported or malformed commands throw `TypeError`, except an out-of-range jump index, which throws `RangeError`. Return the resulting index. Forward movement wraps from the last item to zero, backward movement wraps from zero to the last item, and a jump returns its requested index. Do not mutate the command object. Export exactly `{ moveViewport }` using `module.exports`.
